$description: Tier-2 paths authored BEFORE the grammar existed, listed individually so the list can only shrink. Remove an entry by migrating its call sites, never by editing this file to make a build green. WENT 150 -> 35 on 2026-08-11, by NAMING RULES rather than widening exemptions: the palette-scale shape (color/<x>Scale/<step>, 73 entries) and the alpha-tier shape (color/transparent/<family>/<pct>, 42) both now parse natively — see RULE 2b and RULE 2c in build/grammar.mjs. WHAT IS LEFT IS NOT ALL DEBT, and the difference matters: (a) the 10 color/a11y/* entries are DELIBERATELY RETAINED source for the dark/hc appearance axis, whose EMISSION is switched off but whose overrides are kept so the axis can be revived — see the comment in build/formats/legacy-ds-css.mjs and docs/superpowers/records/2026-08-10-figma-theme-dark-hc-removed.md. Deleting them reverses a documented decision. (b) the other 25 are internal plumbing between tiers: NO app or design-system code references any of them (verified by grep for --sa-<path> across apps/hub/src and packages/design-system, excluding the generated sheets). They are consumed only by the --ds-* compat table and the UX4G parity layer. Retiring them is therefore invisible to consumers and is gated on retargeting those two tables — which tier2-parity.test.mjs already proves is value-preserving for every pair it lists. The migration that actually reaches consumers is --ds-* -> --sa-* in app code, which is a separate job.
